page_title: EIN 1-4 LEV | Eintracht Frankfurt v Bayer Leverkusen 01/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+1' Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players.
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
88' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) takes a mid-range shot, but it lacks accuracy and it goes way over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.
83' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Jonas Hofmann (Bayer Leverkusen) is coming onto the pitch as Jeremie Frimpong cannot continue after picking up an injury.
83' Xabi Alonso decides to make a substitution. Florian Wirtz will be replaced by Emiliano Buendia (Bayer Leverkusen).
80' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.

80' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) was trying to get to the ball but clattered into the legs of the opponent as well. Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for an infringement. A free kick has been awarded to Bayer Leverkusen.
80' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.

80' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal! The ball goes out of play and Eintracht Frankfurt will have a goal kick.
79' The attendance is 58000.
78' We are about to witness a subsitution. Niels Nkounkou (Eintracht Frankfurt) for Nathaniel Brown.
77' Xabi Alonso has decided to substitute Granit Xhaka and he is replaced by Exequiel Palacios (Bayer Leverkusen).
77' Nathan Tella will be replaced by Victor Boniface (Bayer Leverkusen).
72' Today's match ends for Elye Wahi who will be replaced by Jean-Matteo Bahoya (Eintracht Frankfurt).
71' Dino Toppmoller is forced to make a change. Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Michy Batshuayi.
70' Ellyes Skhiri (Eintracht Frankfurt) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
69' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
69' Granit Xhaka (Bayer Leverkusen) makes a rough challenge and Felix Zwayer blows his whistle for a foul. Eintracht Frankfurt win a free kick.
66' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) makes his forward run a little too early and is caught in an offside position after his teammate tries to play a pass to him.

66' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the bottom left corner. However, Kevin Trapp anticipates the shot and makes a brilliant save.
63' Robin Koch (Eintracht Frankfurt) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
62' 1 - 4 Goal! Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) shows perfect technique and produces a first-time effort from just outside the box that goes into the bottom left corner. It's 1:4.
60' Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashes a rocket of a shot towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
59' Eintracht Frankfurt take a short corner kick.
58' Substitution. Patrik Schick did his best and is replaced by Amine Adli (Bayer Leverkusen).
57' Eintracht Frankfurt work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

57' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. Good work from Eintracht Frankfurt as they win a corner.
54' The injury to Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.

54' The game is interrupted. Mario Gotze (Eintracht Frankfurt) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did. It's a free kick to Bayer Leverkusen, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
48' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Eintracht Frankfurt was in an offside position.

48' Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) latches onto a short pass just on the edge of the box and shoots. The effort beats the keeper but comes back off the right post. Close! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Bayer Leverkusen.

47' Florian Wirtz almost found himself in a promising position after Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) tried to send a defence-splitting pass, but one of the defenders reacts well and makes a timely interception.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Hugo Larsson (Eintracht Frankfurt) is replaced by Oscar Hojlund.
46' The game is over for Ansgar Knauff (Eintracht Frankfurt). Nnamdi Collins comes on for the second half.
46' Referee Felix Zwayer blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
41' So close! Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt) tries a curler from the edge of the box, but it slides just wide of the left post.
39' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) unleashed a rocket of a shot aiming towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper denies his attempt with a stunning save.
39' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.

38' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) came close to scoring but should have done much better. His poor attempt from close range ended up in the gloves of Kevin Trapp. The ball is out of play and Bayer Leverkusen manage to earn a corner.
37' 1 - 3 Goal! It's a catastrophic error from the opponent which has gifted a chance to Hugo Ekitike (Eintracht Frankfurt), who rolls the ball into the back of the net from close range. 1:3.
35' Referee Felix Zwayer points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) goes wild in celebration.
34' The Bayer Leverkusen players halt their celebrations as referee Felix Zwayer makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
33' 0 - 3 Goal - 0:3! Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the bottom left corner. Alejandro Grimaldo provided an assist for the goal.
31' The linesman raises his flag. Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) is adjudged offside.
29' 0 - 2 Goal! Nordi Mukiele (Bayer Leverkusen) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 0:2.
29' Aleix Garcia (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner.

26' 0 - 1 Stunning strike! Nathan Tella (Bayer Leverkusen) latches on to a precise through ball from Granit Xhaka before unleashing an unstoppable shot into the bottom left corner from the edge of the area. Fantastic goal. The score is now 0:1.
22' Alejandro Grimaldo (Bayer Leverkusen) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
22' Jeremie Frimpong (Bayer Leverkusen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Bayer Leverkusen win a corner.
14' The corner is swung in but Bayer Leverkusen can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
13' The ball goes out of play. Bayer Leverkusen are awarded a corner kick.

12' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal. Bayer Leverkusen have a corner.
9' Florian Wirtz (Bayer Leverkusen) blasts the ball from just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by the defender.
5' Patrik Schick (Bayer Leverkusen) fires the ball towards goal from outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by one of his teammates.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
The players are out at last! Eintracht Frankfurt will take the kick-off.
Felix Zwayer will supervise the game today.
